items.text: Great tour of Family Health West in Fruita with Dr. Korrey Klein, CEO. Thank you to the team for your dedication to providing quality healthcare in our community. Looking forward to supporting rural healthcare in Colorado! https://t.co/hqDnkf5ggy

Met with Chief Evans of the Upper Pine River Protection District Fire Department. We discussed his plans to upgrade the firehouse by adding on-site EMS-style healthcare services. 🚒 https://t.co/G3ttguuQ3n

Had a great meeting with Kaye Hotsenpillar and the senior leadership team at River Valley Family Health Center. We discussed key issues facing Federally Qualified Health Centers and celebrated the important work they’re doing for the Delta, CO community. https://t.co/YwPNMtgSUz
Great to meet with the National Association of Community Health Centers to discuss ways that we can improve #CO03's healthcare! 🏥 https://t.co/chVqSqDbAF

Rep. Rick Taggart not only represents District 55 in the Colorado legislature—he’s also a key member of the state’s powerful Joint Budget Committee. We met at Coffee Trader in Grand Junction to talk about health care and transportation in #CO03. I am grateful for his leadership. 🇺🇸
Met with community leaders in Rangely to talk about energy, housing, infrastructure, and rural health care in #CO03. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/8nUL0AroKf

Pioneers Medical Center is an economic driver in Meeker, CO, providing excellent care and supporting the community. Like many rural areas, workforce and housing remain challenges. We look forward to partnering with communities to find local solutions in #CO03. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/FAeqIYpNnc
Happy Saturday, everyone! I’m in the San Luis Valley, in Alamosa, meeting with community leaders to discuss three important issues: Education, Healthcare, and Water. 📚🩺💧 https://t.co/pHh2qPR9aq

Konnie Martin, CEO of San Luis Valley Health, is an innovative leader and a strong advocate for rural healthcare. I look forward to working with her to strengthen and expand healthcare access throughout #CO03. https://t.co/OgdxZYkScE

Great conversation with Children's Hospital President Jena Hausmann about the importance of Medicaid to rural Colorado, especially for children and pregnant women. Access to quality care is essential for healthy families and strong communities throughout #CO03. https://t.co/VQy9YA200m

✅ @HouseGOP just passed @POTUS’s budget resolution—moving our shared agenda one step closer to reality. I’m committed to securing the border, unleashing American energy, and reining in reckless spending while protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

Got home late Thursday and was on the road Friday for meetings in Moffat County. First stop: Memorial Regional Health in Craig. Thanks to Board Chair John Ponikvar & CEO Jennifer Riley for the discussion on Medicaid, workforce, and rural health care in #CO03. https://t.co/GP4cW7DQia

Thank you to Don Moore (Pueblo Community Health), Darrin Smith (UCHealth Parkview), and Jason Chippeaux (Health Solutions) for a great discussion on Medicaid, Medicare, and high-quality care for Pueblo families. Grateful for their leadership in #CO03 health care. 🏥🩺🇺🇸 https://t.co/plByQLdXH3

Productive visit with Montezuma County commissioners where we focused on the importance of PILT payments to rural #CO03, strengthening healthcare access, and critical infrastructure priorities. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/7D9P6GGkLc

Great discussion with Archuleta County Commissioners on active forest management, the Fix Our Forests Act, ensuring veterans get the care they’ve earned, and protecting vital benefits like Medicaid. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/HcU0JUuq6X

Started another great day working in #CO03 with a morning in Durango meeting with the La Plata County Commissioners. We covered a lot—public lands, forest health, highway funding, Airport improvements, and the importance of Medicaid to the 21% of county residents who rely on it. https://t.co/9ixsnn7n2x

Welcomed @SenatorBennet to #CO03 for a healthcare roundtable. We discussed the challenges facing critical access hospitals and rural providers, and how to improve Medicaid. We’re concerned that costs keep rising while care isn’t keeping pace. https://t.co/4LxEYNnmHN

Thank you to @ASALifeline for spending time with me to discuss their work in preserving physician-led care! Glad to have had the opportunity to discuss their concerns affecting anesthesiology and the healthcare field. https://t.co/MoguiFkgfz

Stopped by the Conejos County Commissioners' office as part of my San Luis Valley trip. We discussed PILT funding, Medicaid’s impact on local families, forest management, and road infrastructure. Always great to connect with folks keeping the Western Slope moving in #CO03. https://t.co/Vv3wp6iOOU

On #NationalPetroleumDay, we thank the men & women who fuel America. Petroleum powers our cars, homes, business and industry, AND makes plastics, clothing, medical devices & more. It drives our economy, strengthens our tax base, and keeps #CO03 moving forward. https://t.co/UlEgv8AXo6

September is National Suicide Prevention Month, and today is World Suicide Prevention Day. If you or someone you know needs help, please call or text 988—help is always available. Mental health matters, and reaching out can save a life. #SuicidePrevention https://t.co/Sa6PtuczPg

Had the honor of touring the Grand Junction VA Medical Center and seeing firsthand the care provided to veterans across western Colorado. This facility serves those who have served our nation with distinction, including 99-year-old WWII veteran Joe Esquibel. I’ll keep fighting to make sure our vets get the resources and support they’ve earned. They’ve given so much for our freedom, and it’s the privilege of a lifetime to stand up for them in Washington. #CO03

Met with Mike Cafasso, CEO of St. Mary‑Corwin and St. Thomas More hospitals, to talk about strengthening health care delivery in southeast Colorado. As a fourth-generation Puebloan and health care leader who’s expanded services and recruited top providers, Mike’s insight is invaluable. Grateful for his community-first approach as we work to improve care across #CO03.

Delta County Memorial Hospital shows what rural healthcare really looks like in #CO03—dedicated providers serving communities that depend on them. Over 30,000 residents across 1,149 square miles rely on their team to be there when it matters most. Thank you to everyone at Delta Memorial for the thoughtful discussion and tour.

On World Mental Health Day, we recognize that mental health is health. For families in Colorado's Third District and across America, we must end the stigma, strengthen support, and ensure no one faces these challenges alone. https://t.co/CSzZgH6FeH
